about: The one place the repository's Actions policy for pull_request_target is defined (issue #401). From 2026-12-02 GitHub blocks pull_request_target unless a repository Actions policy (Settings > Actions > Policies, rule 'Restrict events') allows it for the workflow file. pull_request_target.allowed: the fork workflows the policy must allow, exactly these. pull_request_target.upstream_blocked: upstream's workflows with that trigger; the fork keeps them disabled and the policy does not name them, so they stay blocked. fork-contracts.test.py (section policies) checks every workflow with the trigger is in one list. fork_checks: the job fork-tests.yml's fork_checks_ran job requires to have passed in the newest pull_request_target run of that workflow on a pull request's head (fork-checks-ran.py), so a blocked, failed or renamed fork-checks.yml fails the required fork-ci-result instead of passing silently. fork-checks-ran.py reads this section from the pull request's base commit (#430), so a pull request that renames the workflow or the job is judged by the names that are live; outside_check names the job that refuses outside pull requests, pinned by the contract test.
